scope: User-supplied offline ground truth only. Never production ASR context, hints or replacement rules. Excludes spurious post-passage recognition.
text: Hi, good morning. My name is Humza. I’m calling on behalf of aPureBase. We provide professional information for healthcare professionals about different disease areas, products, and activities. We also share medical information, product updates, and information about relevant professional events. Our purpose is to make professional information easier for healthcare professionals to access and understand. We work with different types of healthcare communication and provide information that may be relevant to their professional work. We want healthcare professionals to receive useful and relevant information in a simple and convenient way. This can include medical information, updates about products, and invitations to relevant professional activities. The information should be clear, useful, and relevant to their professional work. Healthcare professionals should also have the opportunity to decide whether they would like to continue receiving this information in the future. Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. I hope this gives you a clear introduction to aPureBase and the purpose of our call. Thank you.
